title: Planning approved: 200-unit Submission of details to comply with Condition 11 (Samples of Materials) of pl in Wokingham
excerpt: Wokingham Borough Council has approved 200 residential units at Bridge Farm New Bath Road Twyford Wokingham RG10 9RU. Local sold-price evidence indicates a median price of £470,000; high-level 70% LTGDV senior debt would be approximately £65,800,000.
body:
## Wokingham planning approval

Wokingham Borough Council has approved planning application 261418 for 200 residential units at Bridge Farm New Bath Road Twyford Wokingham RG10 9RU. The approved proposal is: Submission of details to comply with Condition 11 (Samples of Materials) of planning consent 212720 dated 05/07/2023 for outline application for the development of up to 200 dwellings, including 40% affordable housing and associated infrastructure, open space, biodiversity enhancements, landscaping and green infrastructure, following demolition of existing agricultural buildings. Condition 11 relates to samples and details of materials to be used in the construction of external surfaces for Phase 1.

The application was decided on 10/08/2026. Construction Capital has reviewed the local market data for Wokingham, Berkshire to provide a high-level funding view for the site.

## Local sold-price evidence

HM Land Registry sold-price data for Wokingham shows a median residential sale price of £470,000 across 1,770 transactions in the last 12 months. The year-on-year price movement is -5.1%.

| Recent local sale | Price | Date | Type |
|---|---:|---|---|
| 48, KESTEVEN WAY | £378,000 | 2026-06-23 | T |
| 49, CANNOCK WAY | £390,000 | 2026-06-23 | T |
| 5, MILTON COURT, MILTON ROAD | £390,000 | 2026-06-22 | F |
| 36, MERCURY AVENUE | £475,000 | 2026-06-22 | S |
| 61, RAYNER DRIVE | £450,000 | 2026-06-22 | D |

## High-level indicative development finance

Using the available planning and sold-price data, the scheme has an estimated GDV of £94,000,000. At 70% LTGDV, that implies a high-level indicative senior debt facility of approximately £65,800,000.

This is not a credit-backed offer and remains subject to valuation, cost plan, borrower experience, planning documentation, lender appetite, and full underwriting. For a live scheme, Construction Capital can approach the lender panel and provide formal indicative terms within 24 hours.
